SelectorQuery NodesRef.boundingClientRect(function callback)

Query request for the layout position of an added node. Relative to the display area, the unit is pixel. Its function is similar to getBoundingClientRect of the DOM. The return value is SelectorQuery corresponding to NodesRef.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function. Executing the SelectorQuery.exec method returns the node information in callback.

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
id String Node ID.
dataset Object Node dataset.
left Number Coordinates of the left boundary of a node.
right Number Coordinates of the right boundary of a node.
top Number Coordinates of the upper boundary of a node.
bottom Number Coordinates of the lower boundary of a node.
width Number Width of a node.
height Number Height of a node.

Return Value

SelectorQuery

Sample Code

Page({
  getRect () {
    ma.createSelectorQuery().select('#the-id').boundingClientRect(function(rect){
      rect.id      // Node ID.
      rect.dataset // Node dataset.
      rect.left    // Coordinates of the left boundary of the node.
      rect.right   // Coordinates of the right boundary of the node.
      rect.top    // Coordinates of the upper boundary of the node.
      rect.bottom  // Coordinates of the lower boundary of the node.
      rect.bottom  // Width of the node.
      rect.height  // Height of the node.
    }).exec()
  },
  getAllRects () {
    ma.createSelectorQuery().selectAll('.a-class').boundingClientRect(function(rects){
      rects.forEach(function(rect){
      rect.id      // Node ID.
        rect.dataset // Node dataset.
        rect.left    // Coordinates of the left boundary of the node.
        rect.right   // Coordinates of the right boundary of the node.
        rect.top    // Coordinates of the upper boundary of the node.
        rect.bottom  // Coordinates of the lower boundary of the node.
        rect.bottom  // Width of the node.
        rect.height  // Height of the node.
      })
    }).exec()
  }
})
